name: Sora no Fudousan
source:
Near future. Magic has been invented a year ago, and law faculties now study magic. Magic has become an object of numerous regulations. This is a story of a freshman entering such faculty.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
不远的未来。魔法在一年前被发明，如今法学院开始研究魔法。魔法已经成为受到多项法规约束的对象。

这是一个新生进入这所学院的故事。

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
